records.title: 10-K
records.text: On a consolidated basis, Mileage Plan other revenue increased $58 million, or 10%, compared to 2022, primarily driven by higher commissions from our bank card partners due to increased spend levels, annual membership fees, and credit card acquisitions.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: On a consolidated basis, Passenger revenue for 2023 increased by $718 million, or 8%, on a 12% increase in passenger traffic, partially offset by a 3% decrease in yield.

records.text: The improvement is due to $780 million in increased operating revenue, partially offset by $456 million in increased operating expenses and $80 million in increased non-operating expenses.
